title: Physical monitoring and security incident handoff need evidence
remediation: The sponsor physical security operations manager records monitored facilities, intrusion and surveillance coverage, log review triggers and frequency, retention and access restrictions. Sample an alarm or authorized exercise, a dated log review and escalation into organizational incident response. Have privacy officials confirm handling of surveillance records.

milestones.title: Collect monitoring settings, a dated access-log review and a redacted alarm or incident exercise showing response handoff
